premises.text: The home automation market is large but has a low adoption rate
premises.evidence_span: the home automation market is huge and rapidly growing. It's estimated to reach about $52 billion by the year 2020 alone. And yet today, the adoption rate is an abysmal 2%

premises.text: Existing home automation products are difficult to install and use
premises.evidence_span: home automation today looks a lot like this. Why is it that a product meant to make our lives simple and better is such a pain to deal with right out of the box?

premises.text: Wired-in switches and smart light bulbs present significant challenges for consumers
premises.evidence_span: you've got wired-in switches. As you can see, these are a pain to deal with. And if you don't want to do it yourself, you can hire an electrician, but it'll cost you thousands of dollars for a product that costs you about $50 to $60 to buy.

premises.text: Switchmate provides a simple solution for smart lighting without installation issues
premises.evidence_span: we've developed a product that makes smart lighting extremely simple without dealing with any of these issues.

premises.text: Switchmate can be used for various use cases beyond just lighting control
premises.evidence_span: because Switchmate is so easy to use, you can use it for a whole number of other use cases as well.

premises.text: There is a significant market opportunity for automating light switches in U.S. homes
premises.evidence_span: there's about 120 million homes in the United States alone, a third of them being rentals and condos. With about 10 switches per home, that's about 1.2 billion light switches that have the potential to be automated.

premises.text: Switchmate aims to launch a pre-order campaign and expand into retail
premises.evidence_span: we're planning to launch a pre-order campaign. We're also working with a manufacturing partner that has experience building multiple hardware products.

value.text: Switchmate simplifies smart home automation for consumers
value.evidence_span: we will never compromise on making sure we make products that are extremely simple to use.
